verdict.rationale: Greenhouse is an ATS, so offer management is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence pack documents no templated offer letters, dynamic fields, offer approval routing, or built-in e-signature. Offer-related mentions cover only reporting on offers and Offer Forecast, a machine-learning tracker of acceptances. These are adjacent features, not the capability this story asks for.

support.subject: As a recruiter, offers go out from the ATS — templated offer letters with dynamic fields, approval routing, and built-in e-signature
